title: The PDF for meaning is the project's foundation: the vignettes are recent, and the early conversation was not available to the agents (2026-11-06)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: A small note.... semanticops.com and the srs spec start with the PDF for meaning as the foundation. So the vignettes are very recent compared with the project. The srs spec contains some rationale. But the conversation from early in the year was not available to the agents to work with

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-06, responding to the third experiment's report, which said sharing documents to show SRS had no real backing and was mostly new; recorded verbatim.
